name: MonarchAiImageGeneration
title: AiImageGeneration
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.BoxWithConstraints with Row and Column cells, androidx.compose.foundation.Image (through MonarchImage), MonarchSkeleton, MonarchProgress (androidx.compose.material3.LinearProgressIndicator), MonarchTextField, MonarchButton in androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow
summary: Images generated by AI as a grid of variations: placeholders while they generate, previews with progress while they refine, then each image with a required alt text field and "Use image" and "More like this" actions.
whenToUse: In an assistant reply or a creation flow that generates several image variations for the person to choose from and describe.
whenNotToUse: For images that already exist use an image grid or MonarchFilePreview. For one finished artifact use MonarchAiArtifactCard.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiImageGeneration(images: List<MonarchAiGeneratedImage>, status: MonarchAiImageGenerationStatus, onAltChange: (id: String, alt: String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, progress: Float? = null, selection: String? = null, onSelect: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, onVariations: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, error: String? = null, labels: MonarchAiImageGenerationLabels = MonarchAiImageGenerationLabels())
class MonarchAiGeneratedImage(id: String, image: Painter? = null, alt: String = "") { fun copy(id: String = this.id, image: Painter? = this.image, alt: String = this.alt): MonarchAiGeneratedImage }
enum class MonarchAiImageGenerationStatus { Pending, Progressive, Done, Error }

class MonarchAiImageGenerationLabels(label: String? = null, pending: ((percent: String?) -> String)? = null, progressive: ((percent: String?) -> String)? = null, done: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, error: String? = null, announceDone: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, retry: String? = null, imageName: ((position: Int) -> String)? = null, unavailable: String? = null, altLabel: ((position: Int) -> String)? = null, altRequired: String? = null, select: String? = null, selectName: ((position: Int) -> String)? = null, selected: String? = null, variations: String? = null, variationsName: ((position: Int) -> String)? = null)

options.name: images
options.description: The images or their slots, in order: each with an id, a Painter the app loaded (null while generating or when it failed to load) and the alt text.

options.name: status
options.description: Pending: placeholders. Progressive: previews, blurred while they refine. Done: final images with fields and actions. Error: the error message.

options.name: onAltChange
options.description: Called with an image's id and its new alt text as the person types. Store it and pass it back in images.

options.name: progress
options.description: Overall progress from 0 to 1, shown as a percentage and a bar while generating. Values outside 0..1 are clamped; NaN counts as unknown.

options.name: selection
options.description: The id of the chosen image.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Adds "Use image" to each finished image; called with its id.

options.name: onVariations
options.description: Adds "More like this" to each finished image; called with its id.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds a "Try again" button in the error state.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replaces any built-in string; the ones that depend on a number or a position are functions.

states.name: pending
states.description: Each slot is a MonarchSkeleton placeholder (still when animations are off); the status line reads "Generating images…" with the percentage when known, over a progress bar; alt fields are disabled; there are no actions.

states.name: progressive
states.description: Loaded previews are shown, blurred on Android 12 and later; the status line reads "Refining images…".

states.name: done
states.description: Final images; the status line counts them; each empty alt field shows its error; the actions appear when their callbacks are given.

states.name: error
states.description: The images are replaced by the error message: a MonarchInlineErrorRetry banner with onRetry, otherwise a danger MonarchInlineNotice.

states.name: selected
states.description: The chosen image has a thicker ring in the solid assistant color, a "Selected" mark, and its "Use image" button becomes primary and selected.

states.name: unavailable
states.description: An image without a Painter after generation shows "Preview unavailable".

appearance: Square slots with the medium radius and a subtle border on the muted background, the status line in the caption type and the muted text color, and the selected mark as a pill in the solid assistant color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The parity map named LazyVerticalGrid; the images are laid out in plain rows of equal cells instead (as many columns of at least 160dp as fit, the web's 10rem, scaled with the font size), because a few variations sit in a conversation that already scrolls and a lazy grid cannot be nested in a vertical scroll. Images are Painters the app loaded: Monarch adds no image loader, so there is no URL parameter (iOS takes a URL or an Image). The web and iOS bind the alt text; Android is controlled and calls onAltChange. Selection is a value with onSelect instead of a binding. The refining blur uses Modifier.blur, which draws only on Android 12 and later. Completion is announced through a polite live region instead of a posted announcement.
accessibility: The group is a traversal group named "AI generated images", replaceable with labels.label.
Each image has the image role and is read by its alt text, or "Generated image n" while that is empty.
The status line is text; the progress bar is hidden from TalkBack because the line carries the percentage.
Completion is announced once, through a polite live region that is always present, when the status changes to done.
Each alt field has its own label ("Alt text for image n") and, while empty, an error that TalkBack reads.
"Use image" and "More like this" are named with the image's position and have 48dp touch targets; "Use image" is selected on the chosen image.
Placeholders and the "Selected" mark are hidden from TalkBack; an unavailable slot is read as "Preview unavailable".
edgeCases: Large font sizes give one column, so fields and buttons keep their width.
Image ids must be unique; the selection and the callbacks use them.
An image whose Painter is null after generation shows "Preview unavailable" and no actions.
With no images and status done the status line reads "0 images generated".

examples.title: Generate, refine and choose
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3)) {
    MonarchButton(text = "Generate again", onClick = {}, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary, size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm)
    MonarchAiImageGeneration(
        images = images,
        status = MonarchAiImageGenerationStatus.{{status|pascal}},
        onAltChange = { id, text -> images = images.map { if (it.id == id) it.copy(alt = text) else it } },
        selection = chosen,
        onSelect = { chosen = it },
        onVariations = {},
    )
}
examples.code:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3)) {

    MonarchAiImageGeneration(
        images = images,
        status = MonarchAiImageGenerationStatus.Done,
        onAltChange = { id, text -> images = images.map { if (it.id == id) it.copy(alt = text) else it } },
        selection = chosen,
        onSelect = { chosen = it },
        onVariations = {},
    )
}

examples.title: Generating with progress
examples.code:
MonarchAiImageGeneration(
    images = listOf(MonarchAiGeneratedImage("a"), MonarchAiGeneratedImage("b")),
    status = MonarchAiImageGenerationStatus.Pending,
    onAltChange = { _, _ -> },
    progress = 0.4f,
)

parityExceptions.reason: The web example is 614px wide and lays the four images out in three columns. The phone window is 344dp wide and lays them out in two, the same grid with fewer columns, because three squares of 100dp could not hold the alt text field and the two buttons.
parityExceptions.convention: a grid takes fewer columns on a compact window (Material adaptive layout)
